item.title: Oakley Woodlands Group work party (Saturday)
item.description:
Volunteer coppicing and woodland management session with Oakley Woodlands Group at Cowdown Copse, Pack Lane.

Join us for hands-on conservation work helping to maintain our local woodland. All volunteers welcome - tools and guidance provided.
